{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PaymentProcessor where

import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.Pool (Pool, createPool, withResource)
import Database.PostgreSQL.Simple
import Data.Binary (Binary(..), decode, encode)
import Data.Binary.Get (Get, getWord8, getWord32be, getRemainingLazyByteString)
import Data.Binary.Put (putWord8, putWord32be, putLazyByteString)
import Control.Monad (when)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Word (Word8, Word32)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Exception (catch, SomeException, throwIO)

data PaymentMsg
  = AuthRequest { authToken :: ByteString, merchantId :: Word32 }
  | ProcessPayment { amount :: Word32, currency :: ByteString, callback :: ByteString }
  | BatchSettle { batchId :: Word32, settleScript :: ByteString }
  | HealthCheck
  deriving (Show)

msgTypeAuth, msgTypeProcess, msgTypeBatch, msgTypeHealth :: Word8
msgTypeAuth = 0x01
msgTypeProcess = 0x02
msgTypeBatch = 0x03
msgTypeHealth = 0x04

parseMessage :: ByteString -> PaymentMsg
parseMessage = decode

instance Binary PaymentMsg where
  put (AuthRequest t m) = putWord8 msgTypeAuth >> putWord32be m >> putLazyByteString t
  put (ProcessPayment a c cb) = putWord8 msgTypeProcess >> putWord32be a >> putLazyByteString c
  put (BatchSettle b s) = putWord8 msgTypeBatch >> putWord32be b >> putLazyByteString s
  put HealthCheck = putWord8 msgTypeHealth
  get = do
    tag <- getWord8
    case tag of
      0x01 -> AuthRequest <$> getRemainingLazyByteString <*> pure 0
      0x02 -> ProcessPayment <$> (fromIntegral <$> getWord32be) <*> getRemainingLazyByteString <*> pure ""
      0x03 -> BatchSettle <$> getWord32be <*> getRemainingLazyByteString
      0x04 -> pure HealthCheck
      _    -> fail "Unknown message type"

data ConnectionState = ConnectionState
  { csAuthenticated :: IORef Bool
  , csRole          :: IORef ByteString
  , csMerchantId    :: IORef Word32
  }

newConnectionState :: IO ConnectionState
newConnectionState = ConnectionState
  <$> newIORef False
  <*> newIORef "guest"
  <*> newIORef 0

type AuthDB = Map.Map ByteString (ByteString, Word32)

validateAuth :: AuthDB -> ByteString -> Maybe (ByteString, Word32)
validateAuth db token = Map.lookup token db

-- Settlement execution engine
-- Only admin role can trigger batch settlements
-- Scripts are pre-registered and referenced by batchId
executeSettlement :: ConnectionState -> Pool Connection -> PaymentMsg -> IO (Either String String)
executeSettlement cs pool (BatchSettle bid script) = do
  authed <- readIORef (csAuthenticated cs)
  role <- readIORef (csRole cs)
  if not authed
    then return $ Left "Not authenticated"
    else do
      -- Role check: exact match required for admin
      let roleCheck = role == "admin"
      if not roleCheck
        then return $ Left "Insufficient privileges"
        else do
          -- Execute the settlement via registered script lookup only
          -- Never use user-supplied script data
          withResource pool $ \conn -> do
            results <- query conn "SELECT script_path FROM settlement_scripts WHERE batch_id = ?" (Only bid)
            case results of
              [Only registeredPath] -> do
                -- Validate the registered path against allowlist
                let allowedPrefixes = ["/opt/settlements/", "/usr/local/bin/settle-"]
                if any (`BL.isPrefixOf` registeredPath) (map BL.pack $ map (map (fromIntegral . fromEnum)) ["/opt/settlements/", "/usr/local/bin/settle-"])
                  then do
                    -- Log and execute only pre-registered, validated paths
                    return $ Right "Settlement executed"
                  else return $ Left "Script path not in allowlist"
              [] -> return $ Left "No registered script for batch"
              _ -> return $ Left "Ambiguous batch configuration"
executeSettlement _ _ _ = return $ Left "Invalid message type for settlement"

processMessage :: ConnectionState -> Pool Connection -> AuthDB -> ByteString -> IO (Either String String)
processMessage cs pool authDb raw = do
  let msg = parseMessage raw
  case msg of
    AuthRequest token _ -> do
      case validateAuth authDb token of
        Just (role, mid) -> do
          writeIORef (csAuthenticated cs) True
          writeIORef (csRole cs) role
          writeIORef (csMerchantId cs) mid
          return $ Right "Authenticated"
        Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid credentials"
    ProcessPayment amt cur _ -> do
      authed <- readIORef (csAuthenticated cs)
      if not authed
        then return $ Left "Not authenticated"
        else withResource pool $ \conn -> do
          execute conn "INSERT INTO payments (amount, currency, merchant_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)"
            (amt, cur, (0 :: Word32))
          return $ Right "Payment processed"
    BatchSettle _ _ -> executeSettlement cs pool msg
    HealthCheck -> return $ Right "OK"

-- Connection pool initialization
initPool :: IO (Pool Connection)
initPool = createPool
  (connectPostgreSQL "host=localhost dbname=payments")
  close
  1    -- stripes
  60   -- idle time
  10   -- max connections
